title: Tread wear of two tire compounds
intro: Eight test cars each ran one tire of compound A and one of compound B for 20 000 km, and the tread wear (mm) was measured on both. Each car gives a pair: the same driver, roads and weather wore both tires. Does compound A wear differently from compound B? H₀: μ_d = 0 against H₁: μ_d ≠ 0 at α = 0.05, where d = A − B for each car. Read the paired t statistic, its n − 1 = 7 degrees of freedom, the p-value and the interval for the mean difference.
